author: application_boundary_worker
scope: Five new test files only; no application source, build, database, Docker, manifest, memory, or history changes.

verification.reason: Worker assignment forbids builds and test execution; coordinator owns serialized checks.

review.reason: Independent review is assigned to the coordinator workflow after patch integration.

implementation_notes: Application tests assert stable BusinessException codes/statuses and repository non-mutation across malformed create/fact/transition inputs and role/phase boundaries.
Dispatcher tests cover ambient transaction refusal, empty/null polls, delivery order, bounded retry scheduling and retry-state persistence failure.
Trace tests exercise current-span reuse, created-span lifetime, exception propagation, response/request context and MDC cleanup.
Security tests cover credential separation and invalid principal/authority paths; configuration tests cover UTC microsecond clock and workflow path loading.
